SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c); checked addition
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c); checked subtraction requiring b <= a
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c); checked multiplication
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c); division requiring b > 0
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; stages ownership transfer
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner to newOwner and zeroes newOwner
KANYE() constructor; initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the deployer balance
totalSupply() public constant returns (uint); returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant returns (uint balance); reads balances mapping
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool success); moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public returns (bool success); writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without double-spend checks
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool success); moves tokens using balances and allowance
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant returns (uint remaining); reads allowed mapping
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; sets allowance then calls external spender contract receiveApproval
function () public payable { revert(); }; rejects all plain ETH transfers
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner; external call to arbitrary ERC20 transfer
msg.sender; controls ownership, balances and allowance entries throughout the token
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) external call in approveAndCall before any state finalisation
ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) external call to an attacker-supplied token contract in transferAnyERC20Token
